about.title: Za FCIAZ
about.subtitle: Bungwe la dziko linalo lapangidwa kuti mkazi wa Zambia asavutike pa kubadwa.
about.historyBody: FCIAZ inapangidwa mu 2026 ndi madokotala a Zambia, ma surgeon, ndi atsogoleri azaumoyo omwe anaona kuti fistula ndi mavuto pa kubadwa — ngakhale amatha kupewedwa ndi kuchiritsidwa — akupitiriza kuvutitsa amayi ambiri mwakachetechete. Bungwe linapangidwa kuti mavutowa apeze mawu pa dziko lonse.
about.missionBody: Kukhala mawu otsogolera ku Zambia polimbana ndi fistula ndi mavuto pa kubadwa kudzera mu kuthandiza, maubwenzi, maphunziro, chithandizo chabwino, kuyambitsidwa, ndi kafukufuku.
about.visionBody: Zambia pamene mkazi aliyense sadzavutika pa kubadwa, ndipo aliyense wopulumuka adzalandira chisamaliro, ulemu, ndi mwayi.
about.valuesSubheading: Mfundo zisanu zimatsogolera zisankho zonse za FCIAZ.
about.valueDignityDescription: Timaika patsogolo mawu, chisankho, ndi zachinsinsi za amayi opulumuka.
about.valueIntegrityDescription: Bungwe lowoneka, kasamalidwe ka ndalama, ndi maubwenzi owona.
about.valueEquityDescription: Kufika kwa amayi a kumidzi, mosasamala kanthu za maziko awo.
about.valueEvidenceDescription: Mapulogalamu okhazikika pa zamankhwala ndi kafukufuku wa umoyo.
about.valuePartnershipDescription: Timagwira ntchito ndi boma, ma bungwe a akatswiri, ndi anthu.
about.registrationBody: FCIAZ ikulembetsa pansi pa NGO Act ya Zambia. Kulembetsa ndi Registrar, ZRA, ndi PACRA kukupitirira.

board.kasandaBio: Mtsogoleri. Dokotala waumoyo wa anthu ammudzi ku Zambia.
board.kaundaBio: Secretary General. Amatsogolera kulembetsa ndi komiti ya FCIAZ.
board.temboBio: Publicity Secretary. Amatsogolera kuyankhulana, ulemu, ndi mawonekedwe a FCIAZ.
board.kawimbeBio: Mlembi wa komiti. Akulowetsa maphunziro a zamankhwala.
board.zuluBio: Mlembi wa komiti. Amagwira ntchito ndi anthu ammudzi ndi atsogoleri achikhalidwe.

whatWeDo.title: Tinachita
whatWeDo.subtitle: FCIAZ imagwira ntchito m'mizati itatu yolumikizana. Iliyonse ndi yofunikira — palibe imodzi yokha yokwanira.
whatWeDo.advocacyTagline: Kuika umoyo wa amayi patsogolo pa dziko.
whatWeDo.advocacyBody: Timalimbikitsa boma, media, ma bungwe a akatswiri, atsogoleri achikhalidwe, mipingo, ndi anthu kuti fistula ndi mavuto pa kubadwa azikhala pa agenda ya zaumoyo ya Zambia.
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint1: Maphunziro a pa dziko pa tsiku la 23 May (International Day to End Obstetric Fistula).
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint2: Ulendo wochereza ku Ministry of Health, UTH, OGSZ, Medical Council, ndi othandizira ena.
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint3: Mfundo za boma, press releases, ndi media kit.
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint4: Maphunziro ndi atsogoleri achikhalidwe, mipingo, ndi amayi.
whatWeDo.treatmentBody: Timagwira ntchito ndi madokotala ndi zipatala kuti amayi apeze opaleshoni ndi chisamaliro chabwino.
whatWeDo.treatmentPoint1: Njira zotumizira amayi ku UTH Women and Newborn Hospital.
whatWeDo.treatmentPoint3: Kuyang'anira ntchito ya chipatala ndi zotsatira za odwala.
whatWeDo.integrationBody: Kuyambitsidwa ndi mlatho kuchokera pa opaleshoni kupita ku moyo wonse. Timagwira ntchito ndi a physiotherapy, ophunzitsa uphungu, ndi ogwira ntchito za chithandizo.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint1: Physiotherapy ndi masewero a pelvic floor.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint2: Uphungu wa amayi opulumuka ndi mabanja awo.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint3: Maphunziro a bizinesi ndi kupereka ndalama.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint4: Magulu a anthu, kuphatikiza Faces of Hope Campaign.
whatWeDo.researchTagline: Kuphunzira zomwe zimagwira ntchito ndi kuzigawana.
whatWeDo.researchBody: Timagwira ntchito ndi masukulu ndi ofufuza kuti tipeze umboni wa kupewa, zotsatira za chithandizo, ndi zimene amayi opulumuka akumana nazo.
whatWeDo.researchPoint1: Maubwenzi ndi Levy Mwanawasa Medical University, UNZA, ndi Copperbelt University.
whatWeDo.researchPoint2: Misonkhano ya sayansi ndi zosintha za zamankhwala.
whatWeDo.researchPoint3: Kuyang'anira ndi kugawana data ndi Ministry of Health.

stakeholders.title: Othandizira ndi anthu ogwirizana
stakeholders.subtitle: FCIAZ imagwira ntchito ndi boma, ma bungwe a akatswiri, othandizira a pa nseke, masukulu, media, ndi atsogoleri ammudzi.
stakeholders.governmentIntro: Mabungwe a boma omwe amayang'anira zaumoyo wa amayi.
stakeholders.professionalIntro: Ma bungwe a madokotala ndi anesi.
stakeholders.donorsIntro: Othandizira apadziko lonse ndi a mkati omwe amagwira ntchito ya fistula ndi umoyo wa amayi.
stakeholders.academicIntro: Masukulu omwe amapereka kafukufuku, maphunziro, ndi mphamvu ya zamankhwala.
stakeholders.mediaIntro: Ma media omwe amatithandiza kufika kwa anthu a Zambia.
stakeholders.communityIntro: Anthu a pa nthengo omwe amasintha maganizo ndi kufikira kwa anthu.
stakeholders.engagementBody: Ngati bungwe lanu limagwira ntchito ya umoyo wa amayi kapena mavuto pa kubadwa, ndipo mukufuna kugwira ntchito nafe, chonde lumikizanani ndi Publicity Secretary.

getInvolved.title: Lowani
getInvolved.subtitle: Pali njira zambiri zothandizira FCIAZ — kunyumba, mmudzi, kapena kudzera mu bungwe lanu.
getInvolved.donateBody: Thandizo lanu limagwiritsidwa ntchito pa maphunziro, zipangizo za opaleshoni, maphunziro a madokotala, ndi kuyambitsidwa kwa amayi opulumuka.
getInvolved.volunteerBody: Othandizira amathandiza pa zochitika, zomasulira, kufalitsa mauthenga, kujambula, ndi ntchito za akatswiri.
getInvolved.partnerBody: Timakumana mogwira mtima ndi NGOs, zipatala, ma bungwe a akatswiri, masukulu, media, ndi makampani a Zambia.
getInvolved.advocateBody: Gawanani zinthu zathu pa social media, khalani ndi maphunziro ammudzi, kapena kugawa zinthu za maphunziro pa netiweki yanu.
getInvolved.campaignFacesBody: Kubwezeretsa ulemu kwa amayi amoyo ndi fistula kudzera mu nthano (ndi chilolezo), makanema a maphunziro, ndi zotsatira za kuyambitsidwa.
getInvolved.campaignDayTitle: Tsiku la 23 May — International Day to End Obstetric Fistula
getInvolved.campaignDayBody: Pa 23 May, FCIAZ imagwirizana ndi anthu a pa dziko lonse kuti aphunzitse. Dikirani zochitika ndi media.

donate.title: Perekani ku FCIAZ
donate.subtitle: Thandizo lililonse — lalikulu kapena laling'ono — limapangitsa kuti tithandize amayi a Zambia. Thandizo lonse limalandira kalata yolandila.
donate.sectionBankBody: Gwiritsani ntchito zomwe zili pansipa kuti mupereke ndalama ku akaunti ya FCIAZ. Chonde tumizani slip ya deposit pa {email}.
donate.sectionMobileBody: Tumizani mobile money ku FCIAZ. Titumizireni nambala ya chochitikacho.
donate.mtnStep1: Dial *303# (kapena *165#) pa MTN yanu, kapena tsekulani MoMo app.
donate.mtnStep5: Jambulani SMS yotsimikizira ndi kuitumiza pa {email}.
donate.airtelStep1: Dial *115# pa Airtel yanu, kapena tsekulani Airtel Money app.
donate.airtelStep3: Lowetsani nambala ya FCIAZ Airtel Money.
donate.airtelStep5: Jambulani SMS yotsimikizira ndi kuitumiza pa {email}.
donate.zamtelStep1: Dial Zamtel Money USSD code pa Zamtel yanu, kapena tsekulani Zamtel Money app.
donate.zamtelStep3: Lowetsani nambala ya FCIAZ Zamtel Money.
donate.zamtelStep5: Jambulani SMS yotsimikizira ndi kuitumiza pa {email}.
donate.otherInKind: Zopereka zinthu (zipangizo za zamankhwala, makina, kusindikiza)
donate.otherLegacy: Uthenga wa mbiri ndi kupereka kwa nthawi yayitali
donate.thankYouBody: Thandizo lanu limatithandiza kugwira ntchito ndi amayi, mabanja, ndi anthu a Zambia. Pamodzi timalepheretsa mavuto pa kubadwa.
donate.transparencyBody: FCIAZ imatsimikizira kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama mowoneka. Mauthenga a chaka chonse adzasindikizidwa tikangolembetsa ZRA ndi PACRA.

resources.title: Zida
resources.subtitle: Zida zotsitsa, zolemba, ndi zida za media. Zoyenera kusindikiza ndi kugawa mmudzi.
resources.comingSoonBody: Tikukonzekeretsa zida zathu zoyamba. Zikavomerezedwa ndi Executive Committee, zidzawonekera apa.
resources.mediaKitBody: Olemba nkhani ndi mabungwe othandizira amatha kupempha media kit pa {email}.

news.title: Nkhani ndi zosintha
news.subtitle: Zosintha kuchokera ku mapulogalamu a FCIAZ, maphunziro, ndi ntchito za Executive Committee.
news.comingSoonBody: Tikukonzekeretsa nkhani zathu zoyamba. Lembetsani pa newsletter kudziwa.
news.item1Title: Msonkhano wa chipiri wa Executive Committee wachitika
news.item1Excerpt: ExCo yavomereza dongosolo la ZRA, PACRA, ndi kutsegula akaunti ya banki, ndipo yavomereza kuyamba kukonza grant ya Fistula Foundation.
news.item2Title: FCIAZ yatumiza zikalata za kulembetsa ku Registrar
news.item2Excerpt: Pambuyo pa ndemanga zoyambirira pa NRC, zikalata zovomerezeka zatumulidwanso. Mayankho a Registrar akuyembekezeka kumapeto kwa sabata.
news.item3Title: Kupangidwa kwa Bungwe la Fistula ndi Mavuto pa Kubadwa mu Zambia
news.item3Excerpt: Madokotala a Zambia, ma surgeon, ndi atsogoleri azaumoyo aphatikiza kuti apange bungwe la dziko lodzipereka ku kuthandiza, chithandizo, ndi kuyambitsidwa kwa amayi amoyo ndi fistula ndi mavuto pa kubadwa.

contact.formError: Sitingathe kutumiza uthenga wanu. Chonde tumizani pa {email}.
contact.secretariatBody: Pa mafunso onse, maubwenzi, ndi zikalata.
contact.addressValue: Lusaka, Zambia (ofesi idzatsimikizidwa pakulembetsa kwa PACRA)
contact.socialBody: Titsateni pa ma channel athu a official kuti muwone zosintha zatsopano.

volunteer.subtitle: Gawani luso lanu, nthawi yanu, ndi changu chanu. Tidzakukwanitsani ndi ntchito yoyenera mphamvu zanu.
